notes:
Topline: Branchwise Studio builds an IDE-first copilot tightly integrated with customers' monorepos. They want repository-aware context retrieval (embeddings + vector DB) that respects file-level residency and commit-aware freshness. Primary ask: low-latency streaming completions (IDE token stream) + deterministic model/version pinning for reproducible suggestions.

Sales/tech summary:
- Use-case: incremental completion & refactor suggestions in VSCode plugin; context window pulls repo-level embeddings (recent commits prioritized), fallback to symbol-index search.
- Latency target: interactive streaming tail <=50ms per token for local devs (typical local network), end-to-end completion <250ms for single-line completions.
- Throughput: pool must support ~400 active devs concurrently across org; burst to 1200 during sprint days.
- Retrieval: want hybrid retrieval — ANN vector ranking + exact match filters (path, branch, commit timestamp). Support per-org vector namespaces and per-repo retention windows.
- Chunking: prefer semantic chunk size ~150-400 tokens with overlap strategy for function-level context; need tooling to tune chunker for different languages (TS, Python, Go).
